core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haleemat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Patient, forbearing”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haleemat corresponds to the Arabic form حليمات (Arabic root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m); حَلِيمَات (Ḥalīmāt)). Its core sense is patient, forbearing, gentle. Haleemat is the Arabic plural form حَلِيمَات (Ḥalīmāt) of حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma) 'patient, forbearing'. It is used as a personal name in South Asian Muslim communities. The source gloss 'graceful, beautiful' is unsupported; the lexical sense of the underlying singular is 'patient, forbearing'.
